name: Musunde, Hiraite
source:
There is a big stone in a schoolyard. This stone has a legend of love. One day, the stone is broken accidentally and a girl comes out of it. Is she the Goddess of love or...?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106235841/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003040]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
校园里有一块巨石，流传着与爱情有关的传说。一天，巨石意外破裂，一名女孩从中现身。她究竟是恋爱女神，还是…？

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090106235841/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1003040]Eroge Shop[/url]]
